dedupe_keys.name: china city final energy consistency check scripts

description: The China city final-energy research team publishes Stata examples for checking relationships in its city consumption estimates. Two supplementary Word documents contain source commands for correlations with economic output and population, and comparisons with ODIAC and CEADS estimates. The article lists companion Excel inputs. These materials are publicly accessible under the article’s CC BY 4.0 terms unless separately credited. Coverage follows selected Chinese city panels from 2005 onward. The checks can help assess demand inputs used in capacity-planning simulations such as model-pypsa or model-muse-os. A caveat is that the documents contain analysis code, not the algorithm that generated the final-energy dataset. Local paths, imported table formats and additional Stata commands require adaptation; Stata itself has separate licensing. No scripts or companion spreadsheets were executed.
